units.source_text: 住在大堰邸内的明石姬，自念身份微不足数，不欲与他人同时迁入。

en.t: Lady Akashi, who was living at the Oi residence, thought her own status too insignificant and did not wish to move in at the same time as the others.

units.source_text: 直到十月间，他人都已迁定之后，方始悄悄地迁居。

en.t: Only around October, after everyone else had already settled into their new quarters, did she quietly move in.

units.source_text: 迁居时的仪仗，以及其他种种排场，均不逊于其他诸人。

en.t: The ceremonial escort for her move, along with all the other formal arrangements, was in no way inferior to those of the others.

units.source_text: 源氏关心明石姬所生小女公子的将来，所以明石姬迁入六条院后所受种种待遇，与紫姬等无甚差别，非常优厚周到。

en.t: Because Genji cared about the future of the little princess born to Lady Akashi, the treatment Lady Akashi received after moving into Rokujo-in differed little from that given to Lady Murasaki and the others, and was extremely generous and attentive.
